upgrade.sentence: Move to Raid guild? Today you pay $45 for the rest of this year. From 20 Oct 2027 it is $250 a year.

seats.heading: Premium seats
seats.explainer: A seat gives one verified member Premium while the plan lasts. A seat can move once every 30 days.

offered.note: Offered 10 Nov. They pay for Premium, so they accept it first.

whoPays.heading: Who pays
whoPays.help: Hand the plan to another officer, for example when the guild leader changes. The founder price goes with it.
whoPays.consequence: Mirelle gets an offer to take over. When they add a card, they are billed from 4 Nov 2027 at $120 a year, and your plan stops renewing. Nothing changes until they accept.
whoPays.stays: Seats, raids and records stay with the guild; Mirelle manages seats from then.

discord.label: Discord
discord.intro: Get a message in a Discord channel when a server sim finishes or a log finishes parsing.
howSteps: In Discord, open the channel's settings, then Integrations, then Webhooks.
Choose New Webhook, name it something you will recognize, then Copy Webhook URL.
discord.trustHelper: We store the URL encrypted, never show it again, and delete it with your account.
discord.eventUploadParsed: A combat log you upload finishes parsing
discord.eventsNote: Off: private logs are never posted. On: the channel sees the log's name and “Only you”.
discord.removeQuestionPasted: Remove this webhook? Posts stop and we forget the URL. It stays in Discord until you delete it there.
discord.removeQuestionConnected: Remove this connection? Posts stop and we delete its webhook from Discord.
discord.connectExplanation: Discord asks for a server and a text channel, not a voice channel, then lets Forever Sixty post there. You need Manage Webhooks permission in that server. We keep only that webhook, encrypted.
discord.reconnectNote: Connecting again replaces this channel and removes its webhook from Discord.
discord.returnConnected: Connected. Send a test message to see it in your channel.
discord.returnDenied: Cancelled in Discord. Nothing was connected.
discord.returnFailed: Could not connect. You need to be able to manage webhooks in that channel. Ask a server admin, or paste a webhook URL instead.
discord.connectStuck: Discord did not open. Try again, or paste a webhook URL instead.
discord.destinationChannel: Posts to a channel in your Discord server
discord.savedFirst: Saved. Send a test message to see it in your channel.
discord.testRateLimited: Wait a minute before sending another test.
discord.testOurError: Could not send the test. Try again.
discord.removeFailed: Could not remove it. Try again.
discord.saveFailed: Could not save that. Try again.
discord.invalidUrl: That is not a Discord webhook URL. It starts with https://discord.com/api/webhooks/.
discord.notEntitled: Discord messages are part of Premium.
discord.switchedOff: Switched off after 5 failed posts in a row.
discord.switchedOffFix: Fixed it in Discord? Test and switch on. If the webhook is gone, make a new one.
discord.lapsedTitle: Posts are paused because your plan ended.
discord.lapsedBody: We kept your webhook. Posts start again when you are back on Premium.
discord.freeSentence: Discord messages tell you when a server sim or a log you uploaded is done.

copy.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. It becomes foreversixty.gg/go/your-slug.
copy.targetHint: A page on this site, like / or /guides.
